title: Studio: inside a package, the Diagnostics page lists every package's invalid items while the directory's count is scoped, and a foreign row's link opens an unrelated page
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXSZs9PBUc2H8z6mtB

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: Studio `/_console/studio/PKG/metadata` and `/metadata/_diagnostics`, 2 fresh browser loads).
Business reason: an author working in package A opens Studio's All metadata area to see what is broken there. The directory says nothing is wrong, but the Diagnostics page lists another package's problem. Clicking that row lands on an unrelated page in the wrong package, so they cannot reach the item to fix it. Scoping by package is the contract of #28561 ("per package and across packages") and of studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep, which pairs the scoped directory with this page.
Reader who acts: the ui lane (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin`). Pass the active package to the Diagnostics page's sweep, as the directory does, and link each row into its own package's area.
Dedupe: `DiagnosticsPage package` 5 hits (#28561 closed, the feature; #23878, #12038 closed, other shapes; two run records); `diagnostics package scope Studio` 193 (run records and seat posts). No card covers it.

QA-source: #29172 · studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Inside `com.example.showcase`'s Studio, the directory's sweep is scoped. It finds 0 issues, so there is no "View all issues" link. The Diagnostics page at `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/_diagnostics` reads "1 issue(s) across 421 items in 30 types" and lists `pkga_qa_obj.qa_diag_view`, an item of another package. Its link, `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/view/pkga_qa_obj.qa_diag_view`, lands on `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/interfaces?surface=page:showcase_capability_map`, not on the item.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction

1. Create package A: `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.pkga","name":"QA pkg A","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","namespace":"pkga"},"enableOnInstall":true}`.
2. In A, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/pkga_qa_obj?package=com.qa.pkga` (a minimal object with `sharingModel: 'private'`).
3. In A, `PUT` a valid view `pkga_qa_obj.qa_diag_view`. Make it invalid in the run's own SQLite: set that row's `config.columns[0].field` to `123`. This is the planted-invalid recipe the item uses.
4. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata`. There is no "View all issues" link.
5. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/_diagnostics`. Package A's row is listed. Click it.
6. **Expected:** the page is scoped to the package it sits in, as the directory is, or each row links into its own package.
7. **Actual:** the page lists another package's row, and its link opens an unrelated page.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DiagnosticsPage.tsx` L68 calls `useGlobalDiagnostics(client, severity)` with no package.
- `DirectoryPage.tsx` L171 passes `activePackage`.
- On the network, the page requests `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics?severity=error` with no package, beside the directory's `?severity=warning&package=com.example.showcase`.
- The row link is built relative to the current package's area, so a foreign item resolves into the wrong scope.
